step1_analysis.description: A dynamic clocked comparator used in a flash ADC quantizer. It features a double-differential preamplifier, a StrongARM-style regenerative latch, and an SR latch to hold the output state.

paper_reference.title: A 2.2-mW CMOS Bandpass Continuous-Time Multibit ADC With 68 dB of Dynamic Range and 1-MHz Bandwidth for Wireless Applications

power_consumption.description: Average power consumption of the comparator during active clocking.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming 15 comparators in a 4-bit flash ADC, 2.2mW / 15 ≈ 146uW. With 1.8V supply and 200uA tail currents, power is roughly 360uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled from the total ADC power and estimated tail currents for the preamplifier.

clk_to_q_delay.description: Propagation delay from the falling edge of the evaluate clock (CLKB) to the output transition.

sky130_expected.calculation: Simulated delay of the regenerative latch and SR latch stages in 130nm.
sky130_expected.reasoning: 130nm process is slightly faster than 180nm, so delay should be in the low nanoseconds.

dynamic_range.description: Dynamic range of the full ADC.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Requires the full delta-sigma modulator loop to measure.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure power consumption and clock-to-Q delay of the clocked comparator.
